doc.notes: Only the two MIDDLE-pocket wells are declared: they are what the TEST fixtures' leads enter (TEST-terminal-chutes-high: the lead and the chute's first 30 mm inside the well, V16's read of 2026-09-08). The corner cups are unserved by every fixture on this bed and stay furniture. The wells are UNNAMED meshes in web/scene/table.js (a CylinderGeometry under the obTable group), so they are matched by parent, geometry and world box; a rename or a move in the table build breaks the match and V16 names them again — fail-closed.
